Orange Cranberry Nut Bread
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:39pm

Ingredients




4 cups flour
1 1/2 cups sugar
3 teaspoons baking powder
2 teaspoons salt
1 teaspoon baking soda
2 cups cranberries
1 cup nuts, chopped
2 eggs
1 1/2 cups orange juice
4 tablespoons salad oil

Preparation

1 Beat 2 eggs add juice and oil. Add to dry ingredients, mix until moist. Add nuts and cranberries. Grease 2 (9 1/2 x 5 x 3) pans. Divide mixture and pour into 2 pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes or done (toothpick comes out clean). Remove from pan, cool on rack.
